vb_textbox.text: You will see two gnomes. One is a bright colour, like red or purple, the other is dull, like brown. Pick whichever one you want to start with. If this gnome gives you 4 or more mushrooms then keep with this one (for example if you chose the brightly coloured gnome continue with the brightly coloured ones) if it's 3 or less switch to the dull ones. Keep this pattern up throughout the game. If you are receiving 4 or more mushrooms keep with the same type of gnome, whenever you receive 3 or less, switch. You may need to switch between them several times before you get 4 or more. Be quick.
